commands: set -euo pipefail; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "0ad9595b6d1b9a1db69b5a616a5f17932c424ee7"; ADB=/opt/homebrew/bin/adb; MDNS="$("$ADB" mdns services)"; ENDPOINT="$(printf '%s\n' "$MDNS" | awk '/adb-RFCT70L7E8J/ && /_adb-tls-connect\._tcp/ {print $3; exit}')"; test -n "$ENDPOINT"; "$ADB" connect "$ENDPOINT" >/dev/null; APK_PATH="$("$ADB" -s "$ENDPOINT" shell pm path link.localclimate.app | sed -n 's/^package://p' | head -1 | tr -d '\r')"; TMP="$(mktemp -d)"; trap 'rm -rf "$TMP"' EXIT; "$ADB" -s "$ENDPOINT" pull "$APK_PATH" "$TMP/installed.apk" >/dev/null; mkdir -p "$TMP/installed"; unzip -qq "$TMP/installed.apk" 'assets/public/index.html' 'assets/public/assets/*' -d "$TMP/installed"; INST_SIG="$(cd "$TMP/installed/assets/public" && (printf '%s\0' ./index.html; find ./assets -type f -print0 | sort -z) | xargs -0 shasum -a 256 | shasum -a 256 | awk '{print $1}')"; pnpm --filter @lcl/mobile build >/dev/null; MAIN_SIG="$(cd apps/mobile/dist && (printf '%s\0' ./index.html; find ./assets -type f -print0 | sort -z) | xargs -0 shasum -a 256 | shasum -a 256 | awk '{print $1}')"; echo INSTALLED_NORMALIZED_SHA256=$INST_SIG; echo MAIN_NORMALIZED_SHA256=$MAIN_SIG; if [ "$INST_SIG" = "$MAIN_SIG" ]; then echo PHONE_MATCHES_MAIN=YES; else echo PHONE_MATCHES_MAIN=NO; fi; git status --short
